## Real-time nowcasting (`EpiNow2`): the model

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="42%"}
- Reuses the ARIMA(2,1,1) and the negative binomial from the worked
  example
- `broadcast_weekly` wraps the ARIMA to give piecewise constant weekly
  $R_t$
- `ascertainment_dayofweek` adds day-of-week reporting effects through a
  softmax
- Two `LatentDelay` wrappers add the incubation period and the reporting
  delay

::: {.attribution}
Replicating a common configuration of `EpiNow2`, real-time estimation
accounting for reporting delays, right truncation and day-of-week
effects. Abbott et al. (2020),
[doi:10.12688/wellcomeopenres.16006.2](https://doi.org/10.12688/wellcomeopenres.16006.2)
:::
:::

## Real-time nowcasting (`EpiNow2`): results

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- A widely used real-time tool replicated by composing components. It
  took three hours
- **A** to **D** validate each part on its own. **E** and **F** are the
  joint fit, recovering cases through the delays and $R_t$ with them
- Also replicated through `EpiAwareR`, Sebastian Funk's R interface over
  JuliaCall

::: {.callout-important}
No component was edited and no new component code was written.
:::

::: {.attribution}
Figure 4 of the paper. Daily COVID-19 cases from Italy, February to
June 2020, shipped with `EpiNow2`. One configuration replicated, not a
benchmark against the package,
[epiaware.org/approaches](https://epiaware.org/approaches/)
:::
